content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope this email finds you well. I am looking forward to starting our collaboration, but I would like to request a minor adjustment to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the timeline for payments, the relevant clause currently states that payment is due within 45 days after invoice confirmation, which creates cash flow delays; I propose modifying this to state that payment is due within 30 days after confirming thus. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
